verdict.rationale: Maritime hosts agents as Docker images on 'serverless infrastructure' (maritime-docs-1, maritime-probe-1) and provides persistent isolated Linux desktops per end user (maritime-docs-5), which implies agent code runs off the developer's own machines/infra. However, there is no explicit documentation of sandboxing guarantees, resource/network isolation, or security boundaries specifically for running untrusted or AI-generated code safely. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/isolation security model, resource-limit guarantees, and any independent verification that untrusted code cannot escape or affect other tenants/infra.
